exposure: mode of delivery (cesarean section vs. vaginal)
clinical condition (NICU hospitalization vs. healthy, sepsis)
inferred exposure to povidone-iodine used for cesarean skin preparation
cohort: The study included 152 neonates hospitalized in the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) and 50 healthy newborns.
finding: Serum free T4 concentrations were significantly lower in preterm and NICU infants compared with term controls, and also lower in NICU infants delivered by cesarean section and those with sepsis.
mod_finding: Among NICU infants, those delivered by cesarean section had lower free T4 levels than those born vaginally.
cross-section timing: During the neonatal period, at the time of hospital admission/evaluation.
gest_age: Included preterm and term infants, with gestational age evaluated as a key factor.
